entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ?Court No. - 85
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13072 of 2022

Applicant :- Anil Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Suresh Dhar Dwivedi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
01.

Heard Sri Suresh Dhar Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State
and perused the record.

02. The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant- Anil Kumar
with a prayer to release him on bail in Complaint Case No.1266 of 2018, under Sections 420 and
406 I.P.C., P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Bulandshahar.
03.  The applicant has been summoned in a complaint case filed by the complainant with the allegation that the applicant and complainant have been party to an agreement to sell.
The applicant did not appear in the registry office despite notice given by the complainant to execute sale deed.
04. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that nature of the case is essentially civil and filing of criminal case is nothing but abuse of process of court.

The applicant has been summoned on the basis of bald statement of the complainant and witnesses and that the facts are different as the applicant has always been ready to execute sale deed and the fault lies in the conduct of the complainant himself.

sentences.text: 05. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
However, broad out list of the picture of the case as aforesaid could not be repudiated.

06. It may be stated that in case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.
07.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the instant case, I considered submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, a case for anticipatory bail is made out.
Hence, the present anticipatory bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

10. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.
